en.headline: Chief Secretary warns building-upkeep sector bid-rigging days are over
en.dek: Eric Chan said two syndicates had been dismantled, more than 160 people arrested and about HK$230 million in gains seized, as reforms continue after the Wang Fuk Court fire.
body: Chief Secretary Eric Chan urged the building-maintenance trade on Tuesday to abandon bid-rigging entirely, saying participants would have no chance of getting away with it.

Speaking on an RTHK programme, Chan said two syndicates had been dismantled, more than 160 people arrested and about HK$230 million in gains linked to bid-rigging seized. He noted that the Wang Fuk Court fire had exposed how common the practice was in the industry, and that it left owners paying more for poorer-quality work while undermining fire safety.

Chan said nearly 30 of the 120 recommendations in the independent inquiry report had already been implemented, with close to 90 percent to be completed by next year. He stressed that the reforms were driven by a determination to turn grief into action so that such incidents would not happen again.

zh.headline: 陳國基警告樓宇維修業圍標日子已過 兩集團被瓦解
zh.dek: 政務司司長指已拆散兩個集團，拘捕逾160人，檢獲約2.3億元得益，宏福苑火災後改革持續推進。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周二呼籲樓宇維修行業徹底放棄圍標，稱從事者再無機會得逞。
陳國基在港台節目表示，當局已瓦解兩個集團，拘捕超過160人，並檢獲約2.3億元與圍標有關的得益。他指出，宏福苑火災暴露了行業內圍標的普遍性，除了影響消防安全，亦令業主支付更高費用卻得到較差工程。
陳國基說，獨立調查報告120項建議中近30項已經落實，接近九成將於明年完成。他強調改革是出於將悲痛化為行動的決心，確保同類事件不再發生。
